title: Identity-Aware Large Language Models require Cultural Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Proposing a four-stage evaluation pipeline that elicits locale-specific socio-pragmatic norms, derives testable value statements and contrast sets, and evaluates models using QA and preference tasks to measure accuracy, context-appropriate application, and consistency across cultural frames.

Assessing model sensitivity to context-specific language and dialect choices in multilingual societies by prompting models with specific communicative scenarios (e.g., workplace, family, public services) and evaluating the cultural appropriateness of the selected language or variety.
